note: Small reviewed starter coverage. Coordinates are sourced from CC0 Wikidata. Individual photo licences, authors and sources are recorded. Live prices and opening hours are not included.

destinations.description: Explore Mumbai’s waterfront and the Gateway of India.

places.name: Gateway of India
places.description: The Gateway of India stands on the waterfront in Mumbai’s Colaba area. Its arch and harbour setting make it a natural stop for a waterfront walk.
places.previous_description: A waterfront monument in Mumbai’s Colaba area.
places.visiting_notes: Explore the waterfront and surrounding Colaba streets at your own pace. Check official arrangements before adding a ferry journey; this listing does not confirm departures or tickets.

destinations.description: Discover Paris and its landmark Eiffel Tower.

places.name: Eiffel Tower
places.description: The Eiffel Tower is a landmark beside the Champ de Mars in Paris. A visit can focus on the surrounding gardens and views from ground level, or on a separately arranged tower visit.

photo.author: Benh LIEU SONG
photo.changes: Wikimedia thumbnail; resized and cropped for display

places.previous_description: Paris’s landmark tower beside the Champ de Mars.
places.visiting_notes: Choose a garden walk or tower visit before building the rest of your day. Check current entry rules, ticket availability and opening hours with the attraction.

places.name: Louvre Museum
places.description: The Louvre Museum in Paris houses art and archaeology collections in the Louvre palace. Visitors can choose between the exterior courtyards and a museum visit focused on selected galleries.

photo.author: Benh LIEU SONG
photo.changes: Wikimedia thumbnail; resized and cropped for display

places.previous_description: An art and archaeology museum in Paris, with collections housed in the Louvre palace.
places.visiting_notes: Choose a small set of galleries or an outdoor visit to keep the day manageable. Verify the current entry arrangements, tickets and museum hours before travel.

places.name: Musée d'Orsay
places.description: The Musée d’Orsay in Paris occupies a former railway station beside the Seine. It is known for its nineteenth-century art collections and the character of the station building.

photo.author: Sanchezn
photo.changes: Wikimedia thumbnail; resized and cropped for display

places.previous_description: An art museum on the Seine, housed in a former railway station and known for its nineteenth-century collections.
places.visiting_notes: Allow time for the collections that interest you rather than combining too many museums in one day. Check current exhibition details, entry rules and hours with the museum.

places.name: Notre-Dame de Paris
places.description: Notre-Dame de Paris is a Gothic cathedral on the Île de la Cité. Its riverside setting makes it a useful landmark when exploring the historic centre of Paris.

photo.author: P e z i
photo.changes: Wikimedia thumbnail; resized and cropped for display

places.previous_description: A Gothic cathedral on the Île de la Cité in central Paris.
places.visiting_notes: Check current visitor access and reservation requirements with the cathedral. Distinguish an exterior walk from any interior or separately ticketed visit when planning your day.

destinations.description: Explore Tokyo and the historic temple district of Asakusa.

places.name: Sensō-ji Temple
places.description: Sensō-ji is a Buddhist temple in Tokyo’s Asakusa district. The temple approach and surrounding streets offer a distinctive stop for visitors exploring this part of the city.

photo.author: Akonnchiroll
photo.changes: Wikimedia thumbnail; resized and cropped for display

places.previous_description: A Buddhist temple in Tokyo’s Asakusa district.
places.visiting_notes: Treat worship areas respectfully and check any current visitor restrictions. Leave room for a walk around Asakusa rather than treating the temple as a quick photo stop.

destinations.description: Explore New York City and its harbor landmarks.

places.name: Statue of Liberty
places.description: The Statue of Liberty is a landmark on Liberty Island in New York Harbor. Viewing it from the waterfront and visiting the island are different experiences that require different plans.

photo.author: Christian David
photo.filename: Statue of Liberty and a sightseeing boat, Liberty Island, New York.jpg
photo.changes: Wikimedia thumbnail; resized and cropped for display

places.previous_description: The landmark statue on Liberty Island in New York Harbor.
places.visiting_notes: Confirm the authorised ferry, security procedures and the type of access included in a ticket. This catalogue entry does not include a ferry reservation.

destinations.description: Discover Sydney’s harbor and its landmark Opera House.

places.name: Sydney Opera House
places.description: The Sydney Opera House stands on Bennelong Point beside Sydney Harbour. Its distinctive roof forms and waterfront setting can be enjoyed from outside, while tours and performances require separate planning.

photo.author: W. Bulach
photo.changes: Wikimedia thumbnail; resized and cropped for display

places.previous_description: A performing arts venue on Sydney Harbour’s Bennelong Point.
places.visiting_notes: Decide whether you want a waterfront walk, an interior tour or a performance. Check the official programme and availability before adding a paid activity.

destinations.description: Explore Cape Town and its Table Mountain setting.

places.name: Table Mountain
places.description: Table Mountain overlooks Cape Town and forms a prominent part of its landscape. Views, walking routes and access options depend on the route and conditions chosen.

photo.author: Danie van der Merwe from Cape Town, South Africa
photo.changes: Wikimedia thumbnail; resized and cropped for display

places.previous_description: The flat-topped mountain overlooking Cape Town. This pin marks the mountain, not a trailhead or road entrance.
places.visiting_notes: Check current weather, route conditions and any cableway operating information before setting out. Choose a route that suits your experience; a map pin alone is not a hiking route.

destinations.description: Discover Rio de Janeiro and the landmark on Corcovado.

places.name: Christ the Redeemer
places.description: Christ the Redeemer stands on Corcovado above Rio de Janeiro. A visit combines the monument with views over the surrounding city and landscape.

photo.author: Arne Müseler
photo.changes: Wikimedia thumbnail; resized and cropped for display

places.previous_description: The Christ the Redeemer statue on Corcovado in Rio de Janeiro.
places.visiting_notes: Check official access options, ticket arrangements and current conditions. Leave time for the journey to and from the monument rather than scheduling only the viewpoint.
